headline: DeepSeek's flash model keeps its crown at 18.5% share, now on day 3 of the record streak
summary: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 is still parked at #1 and on day 3 of holding its all-time-high 18.5% token share. DeepSeek as a provider now holds 32.1% of tokens, and nobody else is coming close to that particular throne.
highlights: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 is on day 3 of its all-time-high token share at 18.5%, still firmly at #1.
DeepSeek holds 32.1% of provider share, up 7.9% over the last 30 days.
DeepSeek and Zhipu AI together hold 43.6% of tokens, the top two in a row.
OpenAI posted the day's biggest provider gain, up 3.7% in 24 hours.
openai/gpt-6-luna-20260922 climbed three spots to #5 and set its own all-time high at 6.0%.
anthropic/claude-opus-5.5-20260921 jumped 17 places over 30 days to land at #6.
